name: Daily AI Tools Email

on:
  schedule:
    # 10 PM Pakistan Time = 5 PM UTC (PKT is UTC+5)
    - cron: '0 17 * * *'
  
  # Manual trigger bhi available hai testing ke liye
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  send-ai-tools-email:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: 📥 Code checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🐍 Python setup
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: 📦 Dependencies install
        run: |
          pip install requests

      - name: 🤖 AI Tools Email Send karo
        env:
          GMAIL_ADDRESS: ${{ secrets.GMAIL_ADDRESS }}
          GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          python send_ai_tools.py

      - name: ✅ Done
        run: echo "Email successfully send ho gayi! Raat 10 PM PKT"
